### Source inspection (via `read`)

**1. `cli/src/core/beads-shared-server.ts`** — the only `.beads/config.yaml` writer in lane:
`hasBeadsDir` (.beads existence probe) + `ensureBeadsSharedServerEnabled(repoRoot, apply)` — sets `dolt.shared-server:true`, preserves other keys, handles empty/comments-only/scalar YAML. `apply=false` is read-only probe (`changed:true/state:updated` = would-change).

**2. `cli/src/commands/install.ts:runInstall`** — only `apply=true` call site (`!dryRun` → `ensureBeadsSharedServerEnabled(projectRoot, true)`). No migration gate on the direct `install` path.

**3. `cli/src/commands/doctor.ts`** — read-only lane:
`createDoctorCommand` → `ensureBeadsSharedServerEnabled(cwd,false)` probe → `sharedBeadsServerState` in `CatBJson`; `buildSubstrateSection` (`getSbVersion` + `getSbDoctorJson` + `runSetupCheck` fail-open); `buildLegacyMigrationSection` (`hasBeadsDir` + `auditSettings legacy-beads-hook` count + `runSetupCheck naming.beadsRemnants`) → `clean | legacy migration required`. Never writes.

**4. `cli/src/commands/update.ts`** — fail-closed lane:
`updateRepo` runs `planSubstrateMigration` read-only FIRST; `opts.apply && plan.needed` → return `failed` with `migrationBlockedReason` + read-only `runDependencyMaintenance`, before bootstrap/registry/install/staging. `preflightFleetMigration` (apply only) preflights targets + incomplete repos; any `blocked` aborts fleet with zero global mutation. `runInstall` delegation happens only past the gate, so the beads-server write is unreachable on blocked repos via `update`, but reachable via direct `install`.

**5. `cli/src/core/substrate-migration.ts`** — A8 detection/planning only (header: never backs up/exports/imports/verifies/receipts/cleans/writes markers; activation owned by xtrm-6qu.9/A9). `MIGRATION_MARKER=.substrate-migrated.json`, `readMigrationMarker`, `planSubstrateMigration` (marker+no-beads=done; marker+beads=blocked unverified; no-beads=clear; beads=needed), `migrationBlockedReason` (explicit Do-NOT-delete `.beads`).

**6. `cli/src/core/substrate.ts`** — canonical Substrate successor surface (header: verified live `sb 0.1.0`, PRs #163/#168; envelope `{schema:substrate-cli/v1,command,ok,data?|error?}`): `getSbVersion`, `getSbDoctorJson` (ok ⟺ exit0+envelope+`ok:true`+`schemaHealthy:true`), `getSbProjectLink` (doctor `data.link`; no `project list` verb), `linkSbProject`/`createSbProject`, `runSbInit`/`runSbInitForProject` (doctor link is proof, never synthesized), `resolveSubstrateSource`/`resolveSetupTs`, `runSetupCheck` (exact 6-item `EXPECTED_ENROLLMENT_ITEMS` incl `beads-absent`), `runSetupPlan`/`validatePlanCommands`/`executePlanCommands` (verbatim argv, whole-plan validation, abort-first-fail).

**7. `cli/src/core/dependency-maintenance.ts`** — already migrated: `runSubstrateDoctor` (sb doctor read-only gate; comment notes it replaces the old Beads doctor gate). `runGitNexusStatus`, npm `sb` never published (no registry lookup/install for `sb`).

**8. `cli/src/core/settings-audit.ts`** — `legacy-beads-hook` detector (`beads-*.m?js` in hook commands) + `duplicate-registration`/`legacy-path`/`dangling-reference`/`orphaned-key`. Hook findings never fixable here — owned by `xt update --apply` / `scripts/dedupe-legacy-hooks.mjs`. Ownership never inferred from absence.

**9. Tests/guardrails read:** `beads-shared-server.test.ts` (not-applicable/dry-run/comments-only/scalar/enabled/preserve), `substrate.test.ts` (stub-runner envelopes, enrollment strictness, init/link/create, plan validation), `doctor.test.ts` (mocked sb/drift/views, pi packages), `substrate-doctrine.test.ts` (WHOLE_FILES incl `install/update/doctor/substrate/substrate-migration/settings-audit/dependency-maintenance`; allowlist only `doctor.ts:bd-workflow redirect` + parity `bv`; stale entries fail).

`install` vs `update` asymmetry: `update --apply` is zero-mutation on legacy boards, but direct `install` (non-dry-run) still sets `dolt.shared-server:true` inside `.beads/` with no `planSubstrateMigration` check. Executor must resolve with the lane owner before editing — impact is HIGH per graph. No deletion proposed (constraint: never delete on filename alone; content proof above shows the writer is live, not dead).
